text: The Mage class prioritizes dealing high damage with spells and arcane magic.
translation: 法师职业专注于以法术和奥术魔法造成高额伤害。

text: The Marksman excels at slaying enemies from afar.
translation: 神射手擅长从远处击杀敌人。

text: The Vampire uses it's knowledge of blood to gain the upperhand.
translation: 吸血鬼运用其对血液的知识来占据上风。

text: A volcanic eruption spews orbs of magma which explode after a short delay, damaging nearby enemies. Cast speed increases the rate of magma orbs spewing.
translation: 火山喷发喷出熔岩宝珠，宝珠在短暂延迟后爆炸，对附近敌人造成伤害。施法速度可提高熔岩宝珠的喷出速度。

text: Chill and damage enemies in an area.
translation: 冰缓并伤害范围内的敌人。

text: Curse enemies in an area with Debilitation, reducing their damage by 20%
translation: 以「虚弱」诅咒范围内的敌人，使其伤害减少 20%

text: Curse enemies in an area with Brittle, increasing their damage taken by 20%.
translation: 以「脆裂」诅咒范围内的敌人，使其受到的伤害增加 20%。

text: Curse enemies in an area with Protraction, increasing duration of effects on them by 30%.
translation: 以「延宕」诅咒范围内的敌人，使其身上效果的持续时间增加 30%。

text: Curse enemies in an area with Polarize, lowering their Lightning Resistance by 10%.
translation: 以「极化」诅咒范围内的敌人，使其闪电抗性降低 10%。

text: Fires an arrow dealing high physical damage.
translation: 射出一支箭矢，造成高额物理伤害。

text: Slash in an arc towards a nearby enemy, dealing damage in a cone. All Damage is applied as Fire, Lightning, or Cold at random. Every 3rd attack always inflicts a Critical Strike.
translation: 朝附近敌人挥出一道弧斩，在锥形范围内造成伤害。所有伤害随机以火焰、闪电或冰冷伤害结算。每第 3 次攻击必定暴击。

text: Swing a serrated blade at nearby enemies, dealing damage with a chance to inflict Bleeds.
translation: 向附近敌人挥舞锯齿利刃，造成伤害并有几率造成流血。

text: You and nearby allies regenerate life.
translation: 你和附近盟友持续回复生命。

text: You and nearby allies gain Armor.
translation: 你和附近盟友获得护甲。

text: You and nearby allies gain Critical Strike Chance and Cast Speed.
translation: 你和附近盟友获得暴击几率和施法速度。

text: You and nearby allies gain bonuses with Physical Damage.
translation: 你和附近盟友获得物理伤害加成。

text: You and nearby allies gain bonuses with Cold Damage
translation: 你和附近盟友获得冰冷伤害加成

text: You and nearby allies gain bonuses with Toxic Damage.
translation: 你和附近盟友获得毒素伤害加成。

text: Nearby Enemies are afflicted by Dread. Dread causes Enemies to take 25% More Damage per unique Non-Enhanced Elemental Ailment on them.
translation: 附近敌人受到恐惧折磨。恐惧使敌人身上每存在一种独特的非强化元素异常状态，便承受 25% 更多伤害。

text: Projectiles deal damage to nearby enemies on hit.
translation: 投射物命中时对附近敌人造成伤害。

text: Projectiles that can chain to nearby enemies.
translation: 投射物可连锁至附近敌人。

text: Elemental Ailments inflicted by this Skill also apply to 10 random nearby enemies.
translation: 此技能造成的元素异常状态也会施加于 10 名随机的附近敌人。

text: Sacrifices Life to gain Added Physical Damage.
translation: 牺牲生命以获得附加物理伤害。

text: Jolts and Electrocutions inflicted have more effect.
translation: 施加的震荡和电击效果更强。
技能造成更多物理伤害
技能造成更多毒素伤害

text: Fire Damage with skill penetrates Fire Resistance on enemies.
translation: 技能的火焰伤害穿透敌人的火焰抗性。

text: Skill has a chance to inflict Vulnerable on hit, with increased effect.
translation: 技能命中时有几率施加脆弱，且效果增加。

text: Skill has a larger area of effect of curses
translation: 技能的诅咒作用范围更大

text: Jolts and Electrocutions inflicted by this skill have increased effect.
translation: 此技能施加的震荡和电击效果增加。
体质提供附加火焰伤害。
敏捷提供附加闪电伤害。

text: Skill is cast when another skill inflicts a critical strike. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills. All Triggered skills have a 100ms cooldown.
translation: 当其他技能造成暴击时施放此技能。此技能不会自动施放，也无法触发其他技能。所有被触发的技能都有 100 毫秒冷却时间。

text: Skill has a chance to grant a Precision Boon on crit.
translation: 技能暴击时有几率获得精准赐福。

text: Set enemies on fire with Fire Skills
Blast down enemies with a powerful shotgun.
translation: 用强力霰弹枪轰倒敌人。

text: Chance to apply Exposure on Hit
translation: 命中时施加暴露的几率

text: Chance to gain Toughness Boon on Hit
translation: 命中时获得坚韧赐福的几率

text: Chance to gain Precision Boon on Kill
translation: 击杀时获得精准赐福的几率

text: Physical Damage as Extra Added Fire Damage per Toughness Boon
translation: 每层坚韧赐福使物理伤害作为额外附加火焰伤害
每 25 点力量的物理伤害
每 25 点灵巧的毒素伤害
每层坚韧赐福的火焰伤害

text: Critical Strike Multiplier per Precision Boon
translation: 每层精准赐福的暴击倍率

text: Maximum Health Regenerated Per Second Per Toughness Boon
translation: 每层坚韧赐福每秒再生的最大生命值

text: Physical Damage Converted to Lightning Damage
translation: 物理伤害转化为闪电伤害

text: Lightning Damage Converted to Cold Damage
translation: 闪电伤害转化为冰冷伤害

text: Cold Damage Converted to Toxic Damage
translation: 冰冷伤害转化为毒素伤害

text: Physical Damage as Extra Added Fire Damage
translation: 物理伤害作为额外附加火焰伤害

text: Lightning Damage as Extra Added Toxic Damage
translation: 闪电伤害作为额外附加毒素伤害

text: Physical Damage taken as Lightning Damage
translation: 承受的物理伤害视为闪电伤害

text: Lightning Damage taken as Cold Damage
translation: 承受的闪电伤害视为冰冷伤害

text: Cold Damage taken as Toxic Damage
translation: 承受的冰冷伤害视为毒素伤害

text: Lightning Damage as Extra Added Cold Damage against Electrocuted Enemies
translation: 对被电击敌人的闪电伤害作为额外附加冰冷伤害

text: Some love the heat, some love the cold. Why not both?
translation: 有人爱炎热，有人爱寒冷。何不两者兼得？

text: Fires of the past continue to burn with a malignant taste.
translation: 往昔之火仍在燃烧，带着一丝恶意的滋味。

text: A little pep in your step.
translation: 让你的脚步多一分轻快。

text: Burning sensations are replaced by numbness to the pain.
translation: 灼烧之感被对疼痛的麻木所取代。

text: A steady stream of rotational power.
Projectile Hits have a 10% chance to also deal an extra 300% of Damage the target and to Nearby Enemies.
translation: 投射物命中有 10% 几率对目标和附近敌人额外造成 300% 伤害。

text: Skill inflicts Hamstrung for 4 seconds on hit, causing 15% Less Movement Speed
translation: 技能命中时施加断筋 4 秒，使移动速度更少 15%

text: Hitting a Jolted Enemy has a 50% Chance to cause a bolt of Lightning to strike up to 3 nearby enemies, consuming the Jolt. Damage inflicted by Lightning deals damage equal to the initial Hit Damage multiplied by 200% of the Jolt on the original enemy. Lightning can Critically Strike, but it cannot inflict Ailments.
translation: 命中被震荡的敌人有 50% 几率召唤一道闪电击中至多 3 名附近敌人，并消耗该震荡。闪电造成的伤害等于初始命中伤害乘以原敌人身上震荡的 200%。闪电可以暴击，但无法施加异常状态。

text: 10% of Increased Maximum Life also applies as More Area Damage
translation: 增加最大生命的 10% 也同时作为更多范围伤害生效

text: 100% More Life Regeneration per Second if you've taken Damage in the past 5 seconds
translation: 若你在过去 5 秒内受到过伤害，每秒生命再生更多 100%

text: 20% chance to avoid all Damage from hits
translation: 20% 几率避免命中造成的所有伤害

text: Curses have 50% Less Duration, but 30% More Curse Effect
translation: 诅咒持续时间更少 50%，但诅咒效果更多 30%
技能的投射物速度更多 30%

text: 30% More Area of Effect if you've killed in the past 5 seconds
translation: 若你在过去 5 秒内击杀过敌人，作用范围更多 30%

text: Projectiles deal 30% More Damage. Projectiles always travel at their base speed
translation: 投射物造成 30% 更多伤害。投射物始终以基础速度移动

text: Deal 25% More Damage to enemies inflicted with Vulnerable
translation: 对受到脆弱影响的敌人造成 25% 更多伤害

text: Projectiles deal 30% More Damage each time it Chains
translation: 投射物每次连锁造成 30% 更多伤害

text: Recover 2% of Maximum Life when you kill an enemy with Damage Over Time.
translation: 当你以持续伤害击杀敌人时，回复 2% 最大生命。

text: Nearby Enemies are Cursed with Dread. Dread causes Enemies to take 25% More Damage per unique Non-Enhanced Elemental Ailment on them.
translation: 附近敌人被恐惧诅咒。恐惧使敌人身上每存在一种独特的非强化元素异常状态，便承受 25% 更多伤害。

text: Gain 1 Blood Boil for 4 seconds when hit. Gain 20% Increased Life Recovery per Blood Boil, 15% Less Damage Taken per Blood Boil. Upon reaching 5 Blood Boils, release a powerful Blood Burst.
translation: 被击中时获得 1 层沸血，持续 4 秒。每层沸血使生命回复增加 20%，受到的伤害更少 15%。达到 5 层沸血时，释放一次强力的鲜血爆发。

text: Nearby enemies have Lightning Resistance equal to yours.
translation: 附近敌人的闪电抗性等同于你。

text: Physical Damage can inflict Toxic Ailments.
translation: 物理伤害可以施加毒素异常状态。

text: Deal 60% More Damage if both a Melee Weapon and any Shield are equipped.
translation: 同时装备近战武器和任意盾牌时，造成 60% 更多伤害。

text: All Damage is applied as Cold Damage. Deal no non-Cold Damage.
translation: 所有伤害以冰冷伤害结算。不造成非冰冷伤害。

text: Damage penetrates 1% Lightning Resistance for each ailment affecting the enemy
translation: 敌人身上每有一种异常状态，伤害便穿透 1% 闪电抗性

text: Poisoned Enemies always have -100% Cold Resistance.
translation: 中毒敌人的冰冷抗性恒为 -100%。

text: Gain 50% of Increased Movement Speed as Increased Cast Speed
translation: 获得增加移动速度的 50% 作为增加施法速度
